A '''R'rüker'at knife''' was a [[Knife/Legends|blade]] forged by [[Alwari]] smiths in the jungles of [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]].<ref name="CNII">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] carried two r'rüker'at knives that were designed to be hidden in plain sight on her belt, appearing only as part of the belt's complex intaglio design.<ref name="CNII" />

*''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''
